description: Defines result-score bonus conditions, their per-mode thresholds, caps and awarded points.

Id.technical: FName import key/row name for FGameDataTableRow_ResultScore. AGameBattleManager::EvaluateResultBonuses collects all rows in ResultScoreDataTables (DTM+0x360); no consumer reads the member as data.

ResultScore.simple: Which result bonus this row defines.
ResultScore.technical: EGameResultScore, default None. Stored as the bonus entry Type and used in EvaluateResultBonuses' switch: win/overwhelming-win depend on winner and remaining stock, good-fight compares rival stock to a threshold ratio, log-driven bonuses query total battle-log values, and special cases include first attack/kill, runner, kill streak and no-operation. Rows whose enum has no case add nothing. A Runner-only cleanup later keeps just the farthest mover.

Threshold.simple: Default threshold for the bonus condition.
Threshold.technical: float, default 0.0f. Used when BattleMode is not 2, 5, 6 or 9. It is compared against rival-stock ratio for GoodFight, elapsed TimeLimit for FastFinish, consecutive log value differences for KillStreak, log ValueA4 for Involvement, and minimum log values for LongShot/ReturnToHell/NoOperation. Exported rows use varied units (0.5, 60, 3000, etc.) chosen by the bonus case.

Threshold_Story.simple: Threshold override for Story battle mode.
Threshold_Story.technical: float, default 0.0f. Selected when BattleMode == 2; other modes use Threshold or the PvE/Arcade variants. The same comparison logic then consumes it as the mode-specific threshold.

Threshold_PvE_Normal.simple: Threshold override for normal PvE missions.
Threshold_PvE_Normal.technical: float, default 0.0f. Selected for BattleMode 5 or 6 when Game->PvESettings.MissionKind != 2.

Threshold_PvE_Survival.simple: Threshold override for PvE survival missions.
Threshold_PvE_Survival.technical: float, default 0.0f. Selected for BattleMode 5 or 6 when Game->PvESettings.MissionKind == 2.

Threshold_Arcade.simple: Threshold override for Arcade battle mode.

UpperLimit.simple: Maximum counted quantity for scaled bonuses.
UpperLimit.technical: int32, default 0. In the Scaled helper the battle-log value is truncated to int32; when UpperLimit > 0 the count is clamped with FMath::Min(Count, UpperLimit) before multiplying by Score. An UpperLimit of 0 means no cap. It does not affect flat/boolean bonuses.

Score.simple: Points awarded for this result bonus.
Score.technical: int32, default 0. Initialises Entry.Value; scaled bonuses replace it with Count * Score, while boolean/condition bonuses add the initial value as-is. The value also appears in result snapshots, ranking-record bonus checks and bonus-rank evaluation via GetBonusScoreRank.

notes: The exported asset has 34 rows with FGameDataTableRow_ResultScore; the manager loads ResultScoreDataTable into ResultScoreDataTables (DTM+0x360).
Threshold variants are selected by BattleMode with explicit mode numbers (2 Story, 5/6 PvE, 9 Arcade) recorded in the reconstructed source; other modes use the default Threshold.

Bonuses are evaluated per character, with bonus entries keyed by character index. The ResultScore enum drives the concrete condition; the same enum is later used by ranking-record and bonus-rank code.
Evaluator 0x1049fa0 / 0x1015b50 and related helpers are reconstructed; consult status/functions.json for byte status. Content is partial and Blueprint uses were not exhaustively inspected.

usages.detail: EvaluateResultBonuses collects all result-score rows and evaluates them per character.
Scaled helper caps log counts with UpperLimit and multiplies by Score.
Ranking-record evaluation tests bonus entries produced from these rows.
PvE result passes accumulated bonuses to GetBonusScoreRank with the mission score-rate multiplier.
